Accuracy: Accuracy increases the chance for the unit to hit with ranged and melee attacks.
Affliction Duration: Affliction duration increases the duration of afflictions used by the unit.
Affliction Potency: Affliction potency reduces the chance for afflictions used by the unit to be purged.
Affliction Power: Affliction power increases the values of afflictions used by the unit and the chance for them to affect enemies.
Affliction Resist: Affliction resistance reduces the chance for the unit to be affected by afflictions.
Air Adds: Air adds increases air damage which is added to attacks.
Air Piercing: Air piercing reduces the effectiveness of a target’s air resistance against the unit’s abilities.
Air Power: Air power increases the damage and effectiveness of any ability with the air tag.
Air Resist: Air resistance lowers the effectiveness of air abilities on the target.
Alone Damage: Alone damage increases the damage of the unit when it is the last unit left alive.
Alone Defense: Alone defense increases the defense of the unit when it is the last unit left alive.
Amplification: Amplification increases the bonus gained by repeatedly using amplification abilities.  This has no impact on the initial use.
Arcane Power: Arcane power increases the effect of magical abilities that do not have an elemental tag.
Area Damage: Area damage increases the damage dealt by attacks that target all, columns, and rows.
Area Dodge: Area dodge increases the chance for the unit to dodge abilities that target all, rows, and columns.
Avert Sustain: Avert sustain gives the avert condition a chance to remain on enemies even after activating.
Avoid Block: Avoid block reduces the chance for attacks from the unit to be blocked.
Avoid Parry: Avoid parry reduces the chance for attacks from the unit to be parried.
Backbiting: Backbiting increases the damage of backbiting abilities.  It does not affect damage dealt to the unit for using them.
Barrier Threshold: Barrier threshold reduces the amount of damage that triggers barrier, reducing the maximum damage taken from attacks.
Bleed Damage: Bleed damage increases the value of bleed effects used by the unit.
Block Amount: Block amount increases the amount of damage blocked by the unit when it successfully blocks.
Block Chance: Block chance increases the chance for the unit to block attacks by the enemy.
Bloodlust: Bloodlust increases the value of bloodlust abilities.
Break Limit Block: Break limit block increases the maximum block chance able to be gained by a unit.
Break Limit Cast Speed: Break limit cast speed increases the amount of reduction to casting that can be gained by a unit.
Break Limit Counter: Break limit counter increases the maximum counter chance able to be gained by a unit.
Break Limit Critical: Break limit critical increases the maximum critical chance able to be gained by a unit.
Break Limit Parry: Break limit parry increases the maximum parry chance able to be gained by a unit.
Cast Speed: Cast speed reduces the delay used by preparation abilities.
Channeled Power: Channeled power increases the effect of any channeled ability used by the unit.
Chaos Damage: Chaos power increases the damage and effect of any ability with the chaos tag.
Charm Mastery: Charm Mastery increases the adjusted value of charm by a percentage amount.  Mastery abilities do not affect acquisition of abilities.
Clobbering: Clobbering increases the clobber value of clobbering abilities.
Companion Damage: Companion damage increases the damage of a summoned companion.  Companion damage has a greater increase than companion power.
Companion Defense: Companion defense increases the defense of a summoned companion.  Companion defense has a greater increase than companion power.
Companion Health: Companion health increases the maximum health of a summoned companion.  Companion health has a greater increase than companion power.
Companion Power: Companion power increases all statistics of a summoned companion.
Companion Speed: Companion speed increases the speed of a summoned companion.  Companion speed has a greater increase than companion power.
Conserve Focus: Conserve focus grants a unit a chance to not lose focus when it prevents disruption or is used for an ability.
Conserve Hidden: Conserve Hidden grants a unit a chance to retain hidden after making an attack that would otherwise consume hidden.
Conserve Poison: Conserve poison grants a unit a chance to not reduce the uses of poison when making an attack.
Conserve Rune: Conserve rune grants a unit a chance to not reduce the uses of a rune when the rune activates.
Conserve Trap: Conserve trap grants traps placed by the unit a chance to remain after they trigger.
Corrupt Damage: Corrupt damage increases the value of all sources of corrupt damage the unit deals.
Corrupt Resist: Corruption resistance lowers the value of corruption effects that take place on the unit.
Corruption Regeneration: Corruption regeneration causes the value of corruption to go down over time.
Countdown Power: Countdown power increases the value of countdown effects used by the unit.
Counter Chance: Counter chance increases the chance for the unit to counter attacks made against it.
Counter Damage: Counter damage increases the damage dealt by counter attacks used by the unit.
Critical Chance: Critical chance increases the chance for attacks of the unit to be critical hits.
Critical Damage: Critical damage increases the damage dealt by any critical hit.
Damage Purge Power: Damage purge power increases the chance for purges to remove damage afflictions.  Damage purge power is more powerful than purge power.
Damage Resist: Damage resistance reduces the chance for the unit to be affected by damage afflictions.
Damage Shield: Damage shield increases the value of any damage shield ability used by the unit.
Damage Shield Regeneration: Damage shield regeneration restores the value of damage shields over time, up to the maximum value of the damage shield.
Damage Versus Endangered: Damage versus endangered increases the damage dealt to any enemy below the health threshold.
Damage versus Flanked: Damage versus flanked increases the damage dealt to any enemy suffering from the flanked condition.
Damage versus Full Health: Damage versus full health increases the damage dealt to enemies with full health.
Damage versus Incapacitate: Damage versus incapacitated increases the damage against any enemy suffering from incapacitation.
Damage versus Intangible: Damage versus intangible increased the damage against any enemy suffering from intangible.
Damage Versus Maledicted: Damage versus maledicted increases the damage against any enemy suffering from malediction.
Damage Versus Stunned: Damage versus stunned increases the damage dealt by any enemy with the stunned condition.
Damage While Berserk: Damage while berserk increases the damage of any attack made while berserk.  Attacks with the berserk tag gain an increased bonus.
Damage while Focused: Damage while focused increases the damage of any attack made while focused.  Abilities that consume focus deal even more damage.
Damage while Hasted: Damage while hasted increases the damage of any attack made while hasted.
Damage While Hidden: Damage while hidden increases the damage of any attack made while hidden.  Attacks that require hidden gain an increased bonus.
Damage while Intangible: Damage while intangible increases the damage of any attack made while intangible.  Attacks that require intangible gain an increased bonus.
Dark Adds: Dark adds increases dark damage which is added to attacks.
Dark Piercing: Dark piercing reduces the effectiveness of a target’s dark resistance against the unit’s abilities.
Dark Power: Dark power increases the damage and effectiveness of any ability with the dark tag.
Dark Resist: Dark resistance lowers the effectiveness of dark abilities on the target.
Death Protection: Death protection provides a chance for any instant death effects to fail against the unit.
Defense: Defense reduces the damage taken by the unit from physical attacks.
Defense versus Allies: Defense versus allies reduces the damage taken by the unit from all attacks by allies.
Defense versus Compelled: Defense versus compelled reduces the damage taken by the unit from all attacks by enemies compelled to attack the unit.
Defense while Fortified: Defense while Fortified reduces the damage taken by the unit and the unit’s chance to take a critical hit while fortified.
Delays: Delays increases the values of delay effects used by the unit.
Dexterity Mastery: Dexterity mastery increases the adjusted value of dexterity by a percentage amount.  Mastery abilities do not affect acquisition of abilities.
Disenchant Power: Disenchant power increases the chance for disenchant abilities to remove enchantments.
Disenchant Resist: Disenchant resistance lowers the chance for any disenchant effects to work against the unit.
Disruption Power: Disruption power increases the value of any disrupt effect used by the unit.
Disruption Resist: Disruption resistance lowers the chance to lose focus while enchanted with it and for spells to be disrupted while they are prepared.
Distant Damage: Distant damage increases the damage of any ability targeting enemies in the back row.  Distant abilities gain increased bonus.
Dodge: Dodge increases the chance for a unit to avoid attacks.
Dodge while Hasted: Dodge while hasted increases the chance for a unit to avoid attack and spells while hasted.
Dodge while Intangible: Dodge while intangible increases the chance for a unit to avoid attacks and spells while intangible.
Dualwield Accuracy: Dualwield accuracy increases the damage dealt by a unit while they are equipped with two weapons.  Abilities requiring dualwielding gain increased bonus.
Dualwield Damage: Dualwield damage increases the damage dealt by a unit while they are equipped with two weapons.  Abilities requiring dualwielding gain increased bonus.
Dualwield Speed: Dualwield speed increases the speed of a unit while they are equipped with two weapons.  Attacks that require dualwielding gain increased speed.
Earth Adds: Earth adds increases earth damage which is added to attacks.
Earth Piercing: Earth piercing reduces the effectiveness of a target’s earth resistance against the unit’s abilities.
Earth Power: Earth power increases the damage and effectiveness of any ability with the earth tag.
Earth Resist: Earth resistance lowers the effectiveness of earth abilities on the target.
Elemental Damage: Elemental damage increases the damage dealt by elemental attacks.
Elemental Resistance: Elemental resistance reduces the damage and effects taken from all elemental attacks.
Elemental Resistance, Increased Air and: Combined elemental resistances increase both associated resistances.
Combined elemental resistances increase both associated resistances.
Combined elemental resistances increase both associated resistances.
Combined elemental resistances increase both associated resistances.
Combined elemental resistances increase both associated resistances.
Elemental Resistance, Increased Dark and: Combined elemental resistances increase both associated resistances.
Combined elemental resistances increase both associated resistances.
Combined elemental resistances increase both associated resistances.
Combined elemental resistances increase both associated resistances.

Combined elemental resistances increase both associated resistances.
Combined elemental resistances increase both associated resistances.
Elemental Resistance, Increased Fire and: Combined elemental resistances increase both associated resistances.
Combined elemental resistances increase both associated resistances.
Elemental Resistance, Increased Light an: Combined elemental resistances increase both associated resistances.
Empowered Power: Empowered power increases the value of elemental empowerments used by the unit and on the unit.  This can stack.
Enchant Duration: Enchant duration increases the duration of enchant effects used by the unit.
Enchant Potency: Enchant potency reduces the chance for enchants used by the unit to be disenchanted.
Enchant Power: Enchant power increases the value of all enchant abilities used by the unit.
Endangered Damage: Endangered damage increases the damage of the unit when under a certain health threshold.
Endangered Defense: Endangered defense increases the defense of the unit when under a certain health threshold.
Endangered Healing: Endangered healing increases the healing received by a unit when under a certain health threshold.
Endangered Regeneration: Endangered regeneration causes the unit to gradually regain health while they are under a certain health threshold.
Endurance Mastery: Endurance mastery increases the adjusted value of endurance by a percentage amount.  Mastery abilities do not affect acquisition of abilities.
Enhance Power: Enhance power increases the value of all enhance effects caused by the unit.  Enhance power has a greater effect than enchant power, though the two stack when applicable.
Fire Adds: Fire adds increases fire damage which is added to attacks.
Fire Piercing: Fire piercing reduces the effectiveness of a target’s fire resistance against the unit’s abilities.
Fire Power: Fire power increases the damage and effectiveness of any ability with the fire tag.
Fire Resist: Fire resistance lowers the effectiveness of fire abilities on the target.
Full Health Damage: Full health damage increases the damage dealt while the unit is at full health.
Full Health Defense: Full health defense reduces the damage taken while the unit is at full health.
Glancing Damage Dealt: Glancing damage dealt increases the damage dealt by unit on all attacks classified as glancing.
Glancing Damage Received: Glancing damage received lowers the damage taken by hits taken by the unit classified as glancing.
Healing Power: Healing power increases the value of all healing effects used by the unit.
Healing Received: Healing received increases the value of all healing effects targeting the unit.
Health: Health increases the unit’s maximum and starting health.
Hex Power: Hex power increases the value of hexes used by the unit.
Hidden Affliction Power: Hidden affliction power increases power and potency of afflictions used while hidden.  Abilities that require hidden benefit more.
Hidden Critical Damage: Hidden critical damage increases the critical damage dealt while hidden.  Attacks that requires hidden gain an increased bonus.
Ignore Avert: Ignore avert gives the unit a chance to target enemies even if they are affected by the avert condition.
Ignore Compel: Ignore compels gives the unit a chance to target any enemy even if one enemy is affected by the compel condition.
Ignore Counter: Ignore counter gives the unit a chance to ignore the effects of any counter attack.
Ignore Critical: Ignore critical gives the unit a chance to take only regular damage from an attack that would otherwise be a critical hit.
Ignore Disarm: Ignore disarm gives the unit a chance to ignore any disarm effect caused on them.
Ignore Flanked: Ignore flanked gives the unit a chance to not suffer from the flanked condition.
Ignore Glancing: Ignore glancing gives the unit a chance to take no damage from an attack that would otherwise deal glancing damage.
Ignore Lifedrain: Ignore life drain gives the unit a chance to provide no health back to an attacker when hit with a life drain effect.
Ignore Mana Loss: Ignore mana loss gives the unit a chance to not take mana loss from attacks that would deal it.
Ignore Possession: Ignore possession grants the unit a chance to not be affected by possession effects originating from enemies.
Ignore Prone: Ignore prone gives the unit a chance to ignore any prone effect caused on them.
Illusory Damage: Illusory damage increases the value of all sources of illusory damage.
Illusory Regeneration: Illusory regeneration lowers the value of illusory damage on the unit over time.
Illusory Resist: Illusory resistance lowers the value of illusory effects that take place on the unit.
Incapacitate Power: Incapacitate power increases the power, potency, and duration of incapacitate effects, making them less likely to be removed through damage.
Initial Accuracy: Initial accuracy increases the chance to hit for the unit’s first action of each wave.
Initial Damage: Initial damage increases the damage dealt by the unit’s first action of each wave.
Initial Defense: Initial defense reduces the damage taken by unit from each attack before its first action each wave.
Initial Dodge: Initial dodge reduces the chance for the unit to be hit by any attack before its first action each wave.
Initiative: Initiative gives a unit a base timer value at the start of battles and waves.
Intelligence Mastery: Intelligence mastery increases the adjusted value of intelligence by a percentage amount.  Mastery abilities do not affect acquisition of abilities.
Justice: Justice increases the value of justice effects, causing more damage and greater effects based on the difference between the user and target’s health.
Life Drain: Life drain increases the damage dealt and the life restored by any life drain effect.
Light Adds: Light adds increases light damage which is added to attacks.
Light Piercing: Light piercing reduces the effectiveness of a target’s light resistance against the unit’s abilities.
Light Power: Light power increases the damage and effectiveness of any ability with the light tag.
Light Resist: Light resistance lowers the effectiveness of light abilities on the target.
Luck Mastery: Luck mastery increases the adjusted value of luck by a percentage amount.  Mastery abilities do not affect acquisition of abilities.
Solitary Power: Solitary power increases the damage and healing of single-target abilities used by the unit.
Magic Power: Magic power increases the damage and effects of all magic abilities used by the unit.
Magic Resistance: Magic resistance decreases the damage and effects taken from offensive magic abilities.
Maledicted Defense: Maledicted defense reduces the damage taken by the unit from any enemy afflicted with malediction.
Mana Cost Reduced: Mana cost reduced reduces the amount of mana all abilities require to use.
Mana Damage: Mana damage increases the damage dealt by the unit to a target’s mana.
Mana Gained: Mana gained increases the total mana gained from abilities.
Mana Generation: Mana generation increases the amount of mana gained each tick.
Mana Reserved: Mana reserved lowers the amount of mana reserved by prepared abilities by a given percentage.
Maximum Damage: Maximum damage increases the maximum damage dealt by attacks, increasing the range of damage.
Maximum Mana: Maximum mana increases the maximum amount of mana a unit can possess.
Melee Damage: Melee damage increases minimum and maximum damage of melee abilities.
Melee Dodge: Melee dodge increases the chance for the unit to avoid damage and effects from melee abilities.
Mental Purge Power: Mental purge power increases the chance for purges to remove damage afflictions.  Mental purge power is more powerful than purge power.
Mental Resist: Mental resistance applies to any affliction of the mental category.  Mental resist has higher values than the more generic affliction resist.
Minimum Damage: Minimum damage increases the minimum damage dealt by attacks.  If the minimum damage is equal to or greater than maximum damage, the attacks deal that value.
Momentum: Momentum increases the value of abilities with the momentum modifier, gaining increased power from counter above 1000.
Mounted Damage: Mounted damage increases the damage of any attack made while mounted by an additive percentage.  If the specific attack has a mounted tag, this bonus is applied twice.
Mounted Defense: Mounted defense reduces the damage taken by the unit while mounted.
Mounted Speed: Mounted speed increases the speed of the unit while mounted.
Movement Purge Power: Movement purge power increases the chance for purges to remove damage afflictions.  Movement purge power is more powerful than purge power.
Movement Resist: Movement resistance applies to any affliction of the movement category.  Movement resist has higher values than the more generic affliction resist.
Overheal Effects: Overheal effects grants the unit an increased value to any healing above the target’s maximum health in regards to overheal.
Overkill Effects: Overkill effects grants the unit an increased value to any damage above the target’s remaining health in regards to overkill.
Parry Chance: Parry chance increases the chance the unit parries attacks against it.  Parry chance has a cap, which can only be circumvented through limit break passives.
Penetration: Penetration increases the amount of armor ignored by penetrate abilities.  If penetration exceeds 100%, the damage is increased by the left-over percentage.
Percent Protection: Percent protection gives the unit a chance to ignore any attack that deals damage as percent of the unit’s current or maximum health, including heartstrike and decimate.
Physical Purge Power: Physical purge power increases the chance for purges to remove damage afflictions.  Physical purge power is more powerful than purge power.
Physical Resist: Physical resistance applies to any affliction of the physical category.  Physical resist has higher values than the more generic affliction resist.
Piercing: Piercing reduces the effectiveness of an enemy’s magic resistance in protecting against spells.
Pinpoint: Pinpoint increases the value of pinpoint damage and effects
Poison Damage: Poison damage increases the damage and effectiveness of afflictions of poisons.
Possession Power: Possession power increases the chance for possession abilities to successfully work and applies a multiplier to the damage done by possession abilities.
Proc Chance: Proc chance increases the chance that proc effects trigger their related conditions.
Proc Power: Proc power increases the damage and effectiveness of all proc abilities of the unit.
Purge Power: Purge power increases the chance for the character to remove afflictions with its purges.
Purges Received: Purges received increases the chance for purges targeting the unit to successfully remove afflictions.
Quickens: Quickens increases the quicken effect of any ability used by the unit.
Ranged Accuracy: Ranged accuracy increases the chance for the unit to hit with ranged attacks.
Ranged Critical Chance: Ranged critical chance increases the chance for the unit to deal critical hits with ranged attacks.
Ranged Damage: Ranged damage increases the damage of any ranged ability.
Ranged Dodge: Ranged dodge reduces the chance for the unit to be hit with ranged attacks.
Reaping: Reaping increases the damage dealt by attacks with reaping that both miss and hit.
Reduced Affliction Duration: Reduced affliction duration reduces the duration of any afflictions affecting the unit by a percentage.
Reduced Delays: Reduced delays reduces the effect of any delays targeting the unit by a percentage.
Regeneration: Regeneration increases both the value and duration of regeneration affects used by the unit by the given percentage.
Retaliation: Retaliation increases the damage dealt by retaliation effects.
Shattering: Shattering increases the associated value whenever the unit uses a shattering ability.
Shield Damage: Shield damage increases the damage dealt by the unit while equipped with a shield.  Abilities that require a shield gain an increased bonus.
Shield Defense: Shield defense reduces the damage taken by the unit while equipped with a shield.
Shielded Power: Shielded power increases the value of elemental shields used by the unit and on the unit.  This can stack.
Speed: Speed increases how often a unit gets to act.
Spell Critical: Spell critical provides a unit an opportunity to increase the effects and damage of magic attacks.
Spell Dodge: Spell dodge provides a unit an opportunity to lower the effects or avoid entirely magic attacks.
Spell Power while Focused: Spell power while focused increases the damage and effectiveness of spells used by the unit when possessing focus.
Starting Mana: Starting mana increases the amount of mana a unit has at the beginning of battle.
Storm Damage: Storm power increases the damage dealt by attacks and effects of abilities that target randomly.
Strength Mastery: Strength mastery increases the adjusted value of strength by a percentage amount.  Mastery abilities do not affect acquisition of abilities.
Stun Duration: Stun duration increases the duration of stun effects caused by the unit.
Summoning Speed: Summoning speed reduces the cast time of abilities with the summon tag.
Tired Duration: Tired duration increases the value and duration of any tired and exhausted effects used by the unit and reduces any effect of tired on the unit.
Trap Damage: Trap damage increases the damage of any ability that possesses the trap tag used by the unit.
Two-handed Blocking: Two-handed blocking gives the unit a chance to block attacks while equipped with a two-handed weapon.
Two-handed Damage: Two-handed damage increases the damage of any melee attack as long as a two-handed weapon is equipped.
Water Adds: Water adds increases water damage which is added to attacks.
Water Piercing: Water piercing reduces the effectiveness of a target’s water resistance against the unit’s abilities.
Water Power: Water power increases the damage and effectiveness of any ability with the water tag.
Water Resist: Water resistance lowers the effectiveness of water abilities on the target.
Weakness Power: Weakness power increases the value of weakness effects used by the unit.
Will Mastery: Will mastery increases the adjusted value of will by a percentage amount.  Mastery abilities do not affect acquisition of abilities.
Wisdom Mastery: Wisdom mastery increases the adjusted value of wisdom by a percentage amount.  Mastery abilities do not affect acquisition of abilities.
